name: Pendry Chicago
insider_take: This sleek downtown sanctuary perfectly captures Chicago's bold architectural spirit while delivering next-level luxury in the heart of the Loop.
whats_special: Pendry Chicago occupies a stunning 1929 Art Deco building that was once home to the Chicago Motor Club. The hotel's rooftop bar, Chateau Carbide, sits 22 floors up offering panoramic views of Millennium Park and Lake Michigan. The building's original terrazzo floors and brass details have been meticulously restored, blending historic charm with contemporary design.
pro_tip: Book a table at Chateau Carbide during golden hour – the sunset views over Grant Park and the lakefront are absolutely spectacular, and you'll avoid the evening crowds.
dont_miss: The hotel's location puts you steps from the Chicago Theatre's iconic marquee and just two blocks from Millennium Park's Crown Fountain. Art lovers should explore the nearby Chicago Cultural Center, a stunning Beaux-Arts building with free exhibitions and the world's largest Tiffany stained-glass dome.
pros: Prime Magnificent Mile location with easy access to shopping and attractions
Modern luxury design with sophisticated guest rooms and suites
Rooftop bar and restaurant offering stunning city skyline views
Exceptional personalized service and attention to detail
cons: Limited parking availability in busy downtown area
